summary: Whether you show it or not, a serious streak and a quiet fear of not being enough and a need to be free and no patience for being boxed in flow together so easily you can take it for granted. It comes naturally - you build things that last and carry real weight and you think for yourself and break the mold - which is exactly why it's easy to coast on.
body: Whether you show it or not, a serious streak and a quiet fear of not being enough and a need to be free and no patience for being boxed in flow together so easily you can take it for granted. It comes naturally - you build things that last and carry real weight and you think for yourself and break the mold - which is exactly why it's easy to coast on. Innovation inside structure works; an either-or stance stalls.
gift: At your best: you build things that last and carry real weight, and you think for yourself and break the mold.
shadow: The trap: you hold back, harden, or wait for a permission that never comes - or you blow things up just to feel free, or you feel out of control.
integration: Let discipline and limits and freedom and disruption cooperate without making either one carry the whole story. Innovation inside structure works; an either-or stance stalls.
do: Use it on purpose, not on reflex
Let you build things that last and you think for yourself work together
When it spikes, name it before you act
dont: Let the reflex make the decision
